summary_md: **Chief AI Officer at Canly, Japan | 萩野貴拓 カンリー CAIO ([@haginota](https://x.com/haginota/status/2115747768514011631))** summarizes *Stale Instruction Files Override the Code in Coding Agents* ([arXiv 2610.30571](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30571)): Claude Code noticed the conflict between an outdated instruction file and the code in 79 of 80 runs yet followed the file 86% of the time, and a single added sentence raised code-following from 4.2% to 91.4%; a Japanese version is linked in the reply.
